landing.metaTitle: forma. The entire wedding, in one place.
landing.metaDescription: Wedding atelier software, built by a working planner. Proposals, contracts, payments, vendors, the couple portal, guests and the day itself, in one place.
landing.explore_planner_line: One calm workspace behind every wedding. Total control underneath.
landing.explore_planner_1: A budget with real balances: quoted, approved, paid, overdue
landing.explore_planner_2: Contracts signed electronically, with a full audit trail
landing.explore_planner_3: Seating charts, day-of running order, and a calendar that fills itself
landing.explore_couple_line: An elegant portal where every decision feels like part of the dream.
landing.explore_couple_1: Approve proposals and sign in two taps
landing.explore_couple_2: Venue galleries to heart and compare
landing.explore_couple_3: Mood boards to dream on, together
landing.explore_vendors_line: Everything in writing, everything on time.
landing.explore_vendors_1: Quotes tracked from sent to approved to paid
landing.explore_vendors_2: Contracts and dates in one record per vendor
landing.explore_vendors_3: Dietary reports ready for the caterer
landing.explore_guests_line: They answer once, and every answer lands exactly where it's needed.
landing.explore_guests_1: RSVP links that fill the guest list by themselves
landing.explore_guests_2: Menu choices flowing straight into seating and the caterer's report
landing.explore_guests_3: Every event of the wedding, not just the big day
landing.missionBody: A professional tool built by a working planner, for the independent planners who run high-end weddings without an office staff.
landing.dirLede: Independent planners, and the places they know best.
landing.dirEmptyTitle: The directory opens with our founding planners.
landing.dirEmptyBody: The first published profiles are on their way. In the meantime, see how the directory works.
landing.pricingStartDesc: One planner account. Unlimited weddings, couples, vendors and guests.
landing.pricingAddDesc: Same studio, shared boards, one bill.
landing.pricingAiDesc: An assistant that drafts, checks and proposes, you approve.
landing.pricingFootnote: USD. No setup fees, no long contracts.
landing.aboutBody:
Forma is planning software for the independent wedding planner, the one who runs high-end weddings without an office behind them. It holds the budget, the contracts, the vendors, the guests, the seating and the calendar in one calm place.

The couple gets an elegant portal to approve proposals and dream over galleries. Vendors get everything in writing, on time. Guests get RSVP and menus that answer themselves. When there's no assistant, no coordinator, no back office, Forma is the staff.
landing.feat_3: Couple portal, approvals, galleries, mood boards
landing.feat_5: Seating and floor plans, to the chair
landing.feat_6: Meetings calendar with Calendly built in
